page.overview:
Who is Matt?

Matt is the main protagonist of In the Flesh, the second story in Fazbear Frights 5: Bunny Call. He is a narcissistic man who berates and judges everyone in his life. After numerous failed relationships, Matt pours is rage into development of the next Five Nights at Freddy's VR game, unknowingly giving life to his creation.

Matt is considered good-looking with a handsome face and a size 34 waistline. He’s also well dressed. Over time, Matt’s belly gets incredibly bloated, his skin turns yellowish, a hard knot forms on his forehead, his face and hair get drenched in sweat, and his hair gets thinner.

Matt is extremely arrogant and egotistical, believing himself to be a misunderstood genius and constantly seeking admiration through his wealth. He does everything he can to win things, but gets bored maintaining them. This, combined with his lack of empathy towards others, leads to Matt being alone and frustrated constantly. His loneliness and frustration makes him more obsessive over his work, pouring all his emotions into it. Matt also refuses to accept any responsibility, instead blaming everyone else for his misfortune. His distorted view of being wronged and used by others gives him destructive urges, with most of his thoughts being of destruction. Matt also believes women are crazy and abusive, and he tends to judge them purely off looks. He can be absentminded at times, but has an amazing memory when it comes to programming.

Matt is a game developer who got the role of creating the AI in a VR game called Springtrap's Revenge. When he play-tested the game, Springtrap always killed him. His co-worker, Jamie, enters and asks if he needed help. Matt rudely tells her to leave. He play-tested the game again only to get killed by Springtrap again. He then angrily reprogrammed the game to punish Springtrap.
